lines.text: The Sun's atmosphere is hotter than its surface.
Its visible surface is about five thousand five hundred degrees.
Move away from a fire, and it gets cooler. You'd expect the Sun to work the same way.
But its outer atmosphere, the corona, reaches about two million degrees.
That's more than three hundred times hotter, further out.
And exactly why is still one of the big unsolved questions.
So what's hotter than the corona? The full video keeps climbing, and it's linked right here.
